info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Webhook Event Status Update API
info.description: This API allows users to update the status of specific events related to webhook notifications. By providing the webhook ID and event ID, consumers can indicate whether an event has been processed, failed, or is pending. Typical use cases involve monitoring and managing the state of automated notifications in real-time, enhancing the reliability of data delivery systems. This API is particularly useful for developers integrating webhook functionality into their applications, ensuring that event state management is streamlined and robust.

put.summary: Update the status of a webhook event.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the status of a specific webhook event identified by its resource ID. It is essential for managing the flow of events in your application and ensuring that any necessary actions are taken based on the updated status.
